naha-river-national-recreation.name: Naha River
naha-river-national-recreation.seasonality: Walkable year-round; boardwalk slick in freeze-thaw
naha-river-national-recreation.summary: Six miles up the Naha from tidewater to the Heckman Lake cabin, past Roosevelt Lagoon, Jordan Lake, and the falls. Steelhead and salmon in the river, bears on it in season. You still need a boat to reach the trailhead at Naha Bay.

deer-mountain-national-recreat.name: Deer Mountain
deer-mountain-national-recreat.seasonality: Snow lingers on the upper mountain into late June
deer-mountain-national-recreat.summary: Straight up out of town to the ridge. Three thousand feet of gain and the whole channel underneath you when it is clear. Usable today — the question is what happens past the summit.

carlanna-lake.name: Carlanna Lake
carlanna-lake.summary: Out the back of the Carlanna neighborhood to the lake and the dam. Short, steep in spots, and busy on a dry evening.

connell-lake.name: Connell Lake
connell-lake.summary: Forest Service trail along the reservoir. Good ground, and it ends where it starts — getting here from Ward still means walking the road.

dude-mountain-trail.name: Dude Mountain
dude-mountain-trail.summary: A short hard pull to open alpine above the north end. One of the few places you can be in goat country an hour after leaving the truck.

lunch-creek.name: Lunch Creek
lunch-creek.summary: Forest Service tread up Lunch Creek. The north anchor of the interior route, and a walk-in for now.

perseverance-trail.name: Perseverance Trail
perseverance-trail.whatItNeeds: Brushing, tread repair where the boardwalk has gone soft, and a condition walk with the district before anyone calls it a through-route.
perseverance-trail.summary: An old connection north of town. It is still there, but the alders have taken the corridor back and the boardwalk is soft in places. Built ground that does not yet carry a network.

pipeline-trail.name: Pipeline Trail
pipeline-trail.summary: Runs the Ward drainage on old pipeline ground. Wet, easy grade, and already part of how people get from town toward the lake.

salvage-trail.name: Salvage Trail
salvage-trail.whatItNeeds: Corridor clearing, and a decision on whether this stays a neighborhood trail or becomes a link.
salvage-trail.summary: On the ground and brushed over. Not assigned to a priority corridor yet.

silvis-lake.name: Silvis Lake
silvis-lake.summary: Road-end walk to the lakes above Silvis. The missing piece is the ridge coming down off Deer Mountain.

ward-creek.name: Ward Creek
ward-creek.summary: Flat gravel along the creek, good for anybody, and the built start of the run north.

ward-lake-nature-trail.name: Ward Lake Nature Trail
ward-lake-nature-trail.summary: The loop around the lake. Level, wide, and the one trail out here that a stroller or a bad knee can handle.

minerva-mountain.name: Minerva Mountain
minerva-mountain.summary: High ground back of the Ward country. Real elevation, no handrails, and no corridor assignment yet.

frog-pond-trail.name: Frog Pond
frog-pond-trail.summary: Short Forest Service walk. On the map because people use it.

gokachin-trail.name: Gokachin
gokachin-trail.summary: Forest Service tread in the Gokachin lakes country. Remote — you are not walking in from a road.

white-river-nordic-trail.name: White River Nordic
white-river-nordic-trail.seasonality: Ski when there is snow; walk it May–October
white-river-nordic-trail.summary: Gentle ground near Harriet Hunt. Groomed by volunteers in a good winter.

orchard-lake-trail.name: Orchard Lake
orchard-lake-trail.summary: Forest Service trail at Orchard Lake, in the same north country as the cabin routes.

ella-lake.name: Ella Lake
ella-lake.summary: Trail into Ella Lake off the saltwater. Boat access, no road, no crowd.

manzanita-lake.name: Manzanita Lake
manzanita-lake.summary: Walk-in from the beach to Manzanita Lake. Another one that only exists if you have a hull.

low-lake-big-lake.name: Low Lake / Big Lake
low-lake-big-lake.summary: Links Low Lake and Big Lake in the interior lake chain.
